lines: Judkins played 40% of snaps over the last three games, down from 53% on the season, and carries slipped to 12.0 per game from 14.0.
He averaged 9.5 PPR points per game over those three weeks and has 4 total touchdowns this season.
Cleveland has a bye in Week 11. Coach Todd Monken said Judkins continues to split work with Sampson, who has a somewhat different skill set.
